items.title: Manual KPI snapshot at release
items.description: KPI snapshot was written by hand at each release. Automated via .github/workflows/kpi-snapshot.yml (snapshot_kpis.py) on v* tag push: enforces gate, appends snapshot + deltas, records memory entry, resets status, commits back. Remaining manual seam: project-specific metric fetch into metrics.json (documented in scripts/README.md).
items.proposed_automation: Done. Add a project-specific fetch step that writes metrics.json before the snapshot step for fully-automated values.
items.interest_rate: Resolved; only the per-project metric source remains to wire.
